description:
Make a read's retryable conflict surface with its own message, so a lock-free read beside a writer is not reported as a configuration read failure.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/storage/configuration_store.rs` ~19: `load_configuration` wraps every `ConfigurationObservation::capture` failure, including the `@/charter/D-25` retryable conflict, in "Failed to read configuration at '<root>'".
- Benchmark `bb596228`: 1,356 of 1,593 conflict failures (exit 12) beside a back-to-back writer carried that context although the writer never changed configuration.
- Epic `b697a3f7` surfaced pitfall, routed by the steward (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): pass the conflict through unchanged; the conflict error's own text is the one canonical description of the condition (`@/inv/convention-convergence`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A retryable conflict raised during configuration capture reaches the caller unwrapped, with its own typed message and exit code 12; "Failed to read configuration at …" is added only to configuration read failures that are not conflicts. No new conflict message is written at this site.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every other `capture` wrapper on a read path that adds context over a retryable conflict follows the same rule; the worker's report lists each wrapper checked and its disposition.
- [hard] REQ-03: One test shows a conflict raised during configuration capture surfaces as the conflict's own message with exit 12 and contains no configuration-read context.
title: A read's retryable conflict surfaces with its own message
